title: Juice N Power Raspberry Pear 10ml 50/50 E-Liquid
description: Raspberry Pear from Juice N Power delivers a rush of exquisite summer fruit flavour with the taste of fresh, tangy, plump Raspberries blended with soft, luscious Pear. This premium e-liquid’s 50% VG/50PG % blend offers the perfect balance between flavour and cloud production, producing a discreet mount of delicious vapour with a variety of nicotine strengths to suit your personal preferences. PG, or Propylene Glycol, is the ingredient in e-liquid that best carries flavour and provides the tactile throat hit that smokers are used to. VG, or Vegetable Glycerin, is the ingredient in e-liquid that best produces vapour when heated by your vape device’s coil. Along with freebase nicotine, 50/50 e-liquids provide a super-satisfying vaping experience and are versatile enough that they can be used in a variety of vaping kits. If you enjoy this flavour then there are plenty of enticing profiles to explore from Juice N Power’s range of 50/50 e-liquids including delicious fruit flavours, sweet candy, and frosty menthols. Juice N Power are a UK e-liquid producer with a passion for creating bold, delicious flavours across nic salts, shortfills and 50/50 juices. Their juices surprise and delight with unique flavour pairings that use only the best ingredients for a premium quality vape every time.
